text:
olga: opened PR to add novus-lite3b model card + compact migration notes for SDK v4 and a Java snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5310 Preview: https://deploy-preview.example/5310. Adds supported_variants, quantization_profiles, max_sequence_length (6k), throughput_profiles, and a brief perf table. PTAL for docs + eng review.

ben: nice. can you include p50/p95 for 6k on both A100-80GB and an M60 equivalent? also, qa wants a short Java streaming example for backend teams using JVM.

olga: added microbench numbers: A100-80GB 6k p50 410 tok/s, p95 310; M60 ~58% of A100. included an explanation of how `throughput_profiles` maps to `batch_size`/`seq_len` combos. added Java snippet.

kevin: quick schema nit: you added a new field `throughput_profiles` in the frontmatter which is fine, but make sure the card schema docs reference it. also, frontmatter used `sequence_limit` earlier; per catalog schema it should be `max_sequence_length`. linter will fail on CI if not normalized.

olga: thanks — renamed `sequence_limit` -> `max_sequence_length` and added a short docs link to the catalog schema section. pushed.

sophia: can you include an embeddings fallback example recommending `variant: "sparse-lite"` and `quant_profile: "cpu-int8"` for CPU-only hosts? Ops wants copy-paste guidance and a short note about expected throughput delta.

olga: added embeddings fallback block with example config and a sentence: "expect ~3-5x slower embedding throughput on 4GB CPU VMs vs A100; run representative evals on key prompt sets." linked to internal bench artifact: https://bench.internal/novus-lite3b/5310.

ben: also add a tiny migration checklist in the PR description listing changed fields (max_sequence_length, throughput_profiles) and new enum values for `quant_profile`. it'll help platform teams.

olga: added migration checklist and changelog entry.

kevin: CI lint flagged the quant anchor — in the content you link to `#quant-profiles` but the site anchors are `#quantization-profiles`. will 404 in prod. small fix.

olga: fixed anchor to `#quantization-profiles` and updated the TOC. pushed.

sophia: can eng-ml sign off on the CPU fallback language? avoid strong claims about quality differences. @kevin can you add a short sentence to soften it?

kevin: changed wording to "may alter short-token choices; recommend running quick evals on representative prompts before wide rollout." removed any mention of hallucination. linked to eval script snippet in the card.

olga: added Java streaming snippet under Examples: ```java
import ai.redwood.Client;
Client c = new Client(System.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"));
try (StreamResponse s = c.generate("novus-lite3b", "Hello world", true)) {
    for (Chunk ch : s) {
        System.out.print(ch.text());
    }
}
```

also added short curl and Python one-liners for quick smoke tests.

ci-bot: preview build passed \u2705 staging: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/preview/5310. Lint: 1 warning (internal link style) resolved.

docs-bot: requested reviewers @ben @kevin @sophia. please approve when ready — plan to merge after two approvals and CI green. :rocket:
